en.title: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn Trailer Drops, Reveals Stellar Voice Cast Additions
en.summary: A new trailer for Owlcat Games' upcoming sci-fi RPG, The Expanse: Osiris Reborn, showcases thrilling asteroid combat and confirms several key voice actors. Fans can look forward to a star-studded cast bringing the beloved universe to life when the game launches next spring.
en.body:
The universe of **The Expanse** is expanding once more, this time with a deep dive into the ambitious RPG, **The Expanse: Osiris Reborn**. Owlcat Games, known for their intricate RPG design, has just dropped a new trailer that not only highlights the game's dynamic zero-gravity combat on treacherous asteroid mines but also partially unveils the talented voice cast bringing the characters to life. The trailer showcases a tense mission where the player character, the Captain, and their twin, J, venture into an abandoned mine, only to find themselves embroiled in a fierce pirate assault amidst crumbling asteroid debris. This sequence offers a tantalizing glimpse into the game's unique environmental mechanics, where cover can be destroyed and exploration demands careful navigation through hazardous, floating walkways.

Adding considerable weight to the project, Owlcat Games has confirmed some of the key vocal talents. **Alice Himora**, recognizable for her work on **Honkai: Star Rail**, will voice both the Captain and their twin sibling, J. The character Elian will be brought to life by **María Dupláa**, known for her role in **Plum**. **Kerem Erdinc**, a veteran voice actor with credits in **Overwatch** and **Ready or Not**, steps in as Zafar. Rounding out the announced cast is **Leonie Schliesing**, who has lent her voice to **Cyberpunk 2077**, and will now portray the companion character, Polly. This ensemble promises a rich and immersive audio experience for players.

## A Universe of Voices and Languages

The voice cast reveal is a significant step, but Owlcat Games also emphasized the game's global appeal. Beyond the English voiceovers, **The Expanse: Osiris Reborn** will offer a robust suite of localization options. Players can expect subtitles in German, French, Russian, Simplified Chinese, and Spanish. Notably, Brazilian Portuguese subtitles have also been confirmed, underscoring the developer's commitment to making the game accessible to a worldwide audience. The recent announcement also clarified the voice for the male protagonist, with **Blythe Melin** now taking on the role, also voicing his twin brother J, and a new default appearance for the character was revealed in conjunction with this update.

## What This Means for Believers

For fans of **The Expanse**, this news is a powerful signal that the spirit of the series is in capable hands. The emphasis on zero-gravity combat and environmental interaction in the trailer directly echoes the source material's commitment to realistic space physics. The casting of actors with proven track records in acclaimed games suggests a dedication to performance quality that will be crucial for an RPG. The inclusion of diverse language options further cements the game's potential to reach a broad player base, ensuring that the complex narrative and rich world of **The Expanse** can be experienced by as many fans as possible, whether they're seasoned RPG veterans or newcomers drawn in by the beloved franchise.

## Looking Ahead to Spring 2027

**The Expanse: Osiris Reborn** is slated for a Spring 2027 release on PC, Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5. While a precise release date has not yet been announced, Owlcat Games has indicated that more details will be shared in the coming months, with a proper release date announcement expected soon. Players will be able to step into this meticulously crafted universe and make their own choices in the vastness of space.

content_raw: The Golden Joystick Awards are ongoing, and while it’s not on the scale of The Game Awards, some new trailers have debuted. That includes Owlcat Games’ The Expanse: Osiris Reborn , where the Captain and their twin, J, venture to an abandoned mine after taking a stranger’s request. As innocuous as this seems, it leads to fighting pirates on an asteroid – an excellent showcase of the game’s zero-gravity environments. Cover crumbles naturally with rubble floating into space, but it’s not just the gunplay. Even exploration is notably different, as the team carefully navigates walkways. If that wasn’t enough, a companion, Polly, awaits at this location. What would have happened if you didn’t take on the request? It’s hard to say, but for now, things worked out (though one has to wonder if decisions during the quest can affect that). Owlcat Games also announced some of the actors behind its characters. Alice Himora ( Honkai: Star Rail ) plays the Captain and J. María Dupláa ( Plum ) plays Elian, Kerem Erdinc ( Overwatch, Ready or Not ) voices Zafar, and Leonie Schliesing ( Cyberpunk 2077 ) brings Polly to life. The developer also confirmed that in addition to English, German, French, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Spanish, Osiris Reborn supports Brazilian Portuguese subtitles. The sci-fi RPG is out in Spring 2027 for Xbox Series X/S, PS5, and PC. Stay tuned for a proper release date announcement in the coming months.
